title: S002 Inline box margins
reproduces:
GAPS S002: verse lines set as …
straight under , with span.lin { margin-left: 5em } and span.num { margin-left: 2em; margin-right: 1em }. WebKit counts an inline box's horizontal margins in inline layout, so each line starts indented and wraps one more time; the hypothesis is that the engine ignores them.
